configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Ninja, one build directory per preset under build/. /opt/onnxruntime is where ci/install-deps-ubuntu.sh puts ONNX Runtime on releases that do not package it; where it does not exist CMake ignores it and finds the system's.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: Instrumented for gcov. Run the tests, then build coverage-check.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: ThreadSanitizer. See CONTRIBUTING.md for telling this project's races from OpenCV's.

buildPresets.name: coverage-check
buildPresets.description: Both gates. The relaxed one needs a camera and the virtual camera, and the hardware tests run.

buildPresets.name: coverage-check-strict
buildPresets.description: The strict gate alone, which holds wherever the unit and ui tests run.

testPresets.name: tsan
testPresets.description: Reports races without failing the run: ONNX Runtime's and Qt's own thread pools produce reports that are not this project's. See CONTRIBUTING.md for reading them.
